pr_title: [Fix #8099] Fix infinite loop between `Layout/SpaceAroundOperators` and `Layout/HashAlignment` with `EnforcedHashRocketStyle` being an array containing `table`
pr_body:
Although `Layout/SpaceAroundOperators` already had a carve-out for dealing with `table` hash style, `Layout/HashAlignment` allows multiple values for `EnforcedHashRocketStyle`, which was not handled, thus leading to an infinite loop.

Fixes #8099.

issue_context.title: Infinite loop between Layout/SpaceAroundOperators and Layout/HashAlignment with EnforcedHashRocketStyle table
issue_context.body:
## Expected behavior

`Layout/SpaceAroundOperators` with `AllowForAlignment: true` should not complain when a hash is aligned with hashes above it.

## Actual behavior

`Layout/SpaceAroundOperators` complains about extra space, and when autocorrected it is undone by `Layout/HashAlignment` autocorrection, and an infinite loop is reported.

It is also impossible to manually fix for the same reason: fixing for `Layout/SpaceAroundOperators` then makes `Layout/HashAlignment` complain, and fixing for that takes us back to the original `Layout/SpaceAroundOperators` complaint – an endless cycle 😢 

No problems with colon-style, only rocket-style.

## Steps to reproduce the problem

- Have the following rubocop config:
```yml
Layout/SpaceAroundOperators:
  Enabled: true
  AllowForAlignment: true

Layout/HashAlignment:
  Enabled: true
  EnforcedHashRocketStyle:
    - table
    - key
```
- Create the following file:
```rb
# bug.rb in the output above
hash = {
  "one"   => 1,
  "hash"  => {

  },
  "align" => {
    "hello" => "value"
  },
  "deep"  => {
    "hash" => {
      "this is" => "deep"
    }
  }
}
```
- Run `rubocop --only Layout --fix-layout` on that file.
- See the following output:
```
$ rubocop --only Layout --fix-layout bug.rb
Inspecting 1 file

  "deep" => { ...
  ^^^^^^^^^^^
bug.rb:9:11: C: [Corrected] Layout/SpaceAroundOperators: Operator => should be surrounded by a single space.
  "deep"  => {
          ^^

0 files inspected, 2 offenses detected, 2 offenses corrected
Infinite loop detected in /Users/me/Code/my_gemset/bug.rb.
```

This also happens on the `align` hash key if you rename it to `x`, so the preceeding hash doesn't have to contain anything, it just has to have `{` `}` on separate lines:
```rb
hash = {
  "one"  => 1,
  "hash" => {

  },
  "x" => {
    "hello" => "value"
  },
  "deep" => {

    }
```


But no problem with colon-style hashes:
```rb

  one: 1,
  hash: {

  align: {
    hello: "value"

}
```

```yml
  Enabled: true

Layout/HashAlignment:

```
